text:
Maya: OK folks, time to carve the Hosted API roadmap for Q4. I want us to negotiate scope across chat, embeddings, rerank, and cost ops. Goal: a coherent portfolio we can commit to by EOW.
Tom: Agree. We should surface the hard tradeoffs early — latency vs cost vs launch completeness.
Liam: From runtime: primary constraints are batching changes + KV cache expiry. We can hit P95 latency improvements but need 2 weeks of kernel tuning.
Sasha: ML ask: rerank endpoint needs an eval harness + 1% sample A/B to check quality regressions. That’s non-negotiable for customers.
Aisha: DevEx note: any public launch needs docs, SDK updates, and 2 quickstart examples. Assume 1 sprint for SDK + 3 docs PRs.
Diego: Sales: we have 3 enterprise prospects demanding embeddings SLA and predictable cost. If we prioritize embeddings SLA they may sign this quarter.
Nora: Support: expect increased noise if we change streaming behavior. Need rollout plan and a canary with alerting for regressions.
Maya: Proposal: split into 3 slices — "Core Latency" (chat streaming + kernel tunings), "Embedding Reliability" (SLA + pricing guidance + caching), "Rerank & Eval" (API + eval harness + monitoring). Each slice has clear launch criteria.
Tom: +1 to slices. Suggest we rank them by revenue impact and technical dependencies. My ranking: 1) Embeddings SLA, 2) Core Latency, 3) Rerank & Eval.
Diego: Matches sales feedback — embeddings SLA is the lever.
Sasha: But rerank has high ML risk. If we do it half-baked we'll regress customers. Can we make it "beta" with explicit guardrails?
Maya: Yes — for Rerank, launch criteria = (a) automated regression test against baseline prompts, (b) canary with real traffic <5% and auto-fallback, (c) SDK + docs.
Liam: For Core Latency, concrete SLOs proposed: `p95_gen_time <= 450ms` for short chats (<512 tokens) and `p99_latency <= 2s` for streaming start. We can aim to reduce p95 by ~30% with batching+kernel.
Aisha: Docs checklist: 1) migration guide, 2) sample streaming client, 3) changelog entry. I’ll own 1 & 2.
Nora: Rollout playbook needs: feature-flag + canary + alerting (errors, latency regressions, token cost spike). I’ll draft the playbook.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-kernel-tune -> canary -> global rollout (manual approve).
Maya: Launch criteria summary for leadership review:
- Embeddings SLA: 99.9% availability, latency p95 under 200ms for small vectors, pricing guidance published, billing integration QAed.
- Core Latency: SLOs met in canary, console metrics and trace hooks live, SDK streaming sample + docs.
- Rerank & Eval: Regression suite passing, canary with auto-fallback, docs + beta label.
Tom: Time estimates: Embeddings SLA = 4 wks infra + 2 wks docs, Core Latency = 3 wks runtime + 1 wk QA, Rerank = 5 wks (ML + infra) + 1 wk docs.
Maya: Ok — now negotiation. We have ~8 sprint-weeks total across teams. We can fully fund two slices and put the third into "beta backlog". Thoughts?
Sasha: I'd prioritize Embeddings + Rerank (so we ship reliability and quality controls). Latency can be iterative; small perf gains shipped sooner.
Liam: Operationally, Embeddings and Core Latency compete for kernel work. If you pick Embeddings + Rerank, we need extra runtime headcount or to delay latency gains.
Diego: From revenue POV, embeddings SLA first. If customers sign, we can trade committed spend for hiring.
Aisha: From DX POV, whichever two ship we must still release a clear beta note for the third so customers aren't surprised.
Maya: Decision proposal: Ship Embeddings SLA and Core Latency as primary Q4 commits. Put Rerank into a controlled beta with the evaluation work started but not full GA. We’ll re-evaluate after embeddings contracts land.
Tom: I can commit to that if we get 1 additional s/w engineer for kernel tuning mid-Q.
Liam: I’ll scope kernel work and produce a patch plan by Tuesday.
Sasha: I’ll start the rerank eval infra as low-priority so it's ready for beta canary.
Nora: I’ll draft the rollout + support runbook and list required alerts.
Diego: I’ll push for embedding contract closes and flag dependencies to legal.
Maya: Great. Action items: Tom -> req for headcount + tech plan; Liam -> kernel plan Tue; Sasha -> rerank eval stub; Aisha -> docs checklist; Nora -> runbook; Diego -> sales commitments. We’ll review Wed @10am.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Sasha: :ok_hand:
Nora: noted.
Aisha: will sync with SDK owners.
Maya: Thanks team — posting this as the Q4 Hosted API portfolio negotiation thread. We’ll attach the decision to the roadmap doc after Wed review.
